content: Supplier B processes transaction records for major international partners, including Company X. Supplier B stores all received Customer Data in its primary servers located in a Foreign Jurisdiction (specifically, Jurisdiction F). Supplier B undergoes a periodic Cybersecurity Audit to verify compliance with local laws. This audit is conducted by a Third-Party Auditor appointed by Jurisdiction F's corporate regulator. Jurisdiction F does not have a formal data protection adequacy treaty with the US, and local regulatory laws permit local government agencies to inspect foreign-owned datasets under national security provisions.
